# Clauses this repository must keep carrying. One per line:
#
#     path/to/file :: text that must appear somewhere in it
#
# `#` starts a comment only at the beginning of a line, because a clause is a
# fragment of prose and markdown headings begin with one. Whitespace is
# collapsed on both sides before matching, so a rewrap is not a policy change.
#
# Pin the shortest fragment that cannot survive the deletion you are guarding
# against. Retiring a clause is a deliberate act: do it in its own commit, so
# the decision is visible in the history rather than in a merge nobody read.
#
# Every clause below quotes THIS repository's own wording. The checker and its
# self-test are byte-for-byte copies of the organisation's shared scripts; this
# file is not, and must never be copied from another repository.
#
# Pin files whose CONTENT is the policy, not files whose content is code. A
# workflow's jobs are guarded by `check-aggregate-covers-jobs.py` instead.

# ── the attribution rule ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# The attribution gate scans for the vendor name and has no opinion about the
# policy mandating it going away. Both the section and the rule under it are
# pinned, because the heading can survive while the rule is emptied.
AGENTS.md :: ## Assistant attribution — hard rule
AGENTS.md :: Never name an AI assistant, its vendor, or a model
AGENTS.md :: a commit author or committer identity

# ── how changes reach main ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
AGENTS.md :: Never commit to `main` or `master`.
MAINTENANCE.md :: Preserve unrelated work and never commit to `main` or `master`.
MAINTENANCE.md :: Leave merging to a maintainer

# ── what a link check may accept ────────────────────────────────────────────
# Weakening this is how a red check gets "fixed" without fixing anything.
MAINTENANCE.md :: Never broadly accept 401, 403, 429, 5xx or redirect loops.
MAINTENANCE.md :: max validity is 14 days
